text:
ari (AE): Heads up — Acme Robotics asking if we can discount concurrent-node licenses for their private deploy POC. They want 6 nodes but only have steady load for 3, asking price for 3 concurrent + 3 standby at 40% off for first 3 months.
sam (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifier — are the standby nodes powered but idling (reserved GPUs) or fully deprovisioned and cold? Affects platform fee and commit.
ari (AE): Standby = reserved (warm), customer needs instant failover. Can't accept cold.
jess (Sales Ops): Their current quote shows: platform fee (monthly) + per-node reserved unit price. Discounting reserved units reduces revenue a lot unless we adjust platform fee.
maria (Deal Desk): We can consider a short-term operational credit but need finance signoff for any >25% ARR impact. What's the total ARR equivalent on this POC?
ari (AE): At list: platform fee $6k/mo + 6 nodes * $2k/node = $18k/mo -> $24k/mo total. Proposed 40% off on 3 nodes = $2.4k/mo discount for 3 months = ~$7.2k credit. Also they want lower on-platform-fee for POC (waive 50% first month).
shawn (Finance): $7.2k is material but within discretionary credits if we attach a commit trigger (e.g., convert to dedicated commit of 6 nodes within 90 days at 12-month term). Need MQL approval and expected conversion probability >60%.
sam (Solutions Eng): From tech POV, we can enforce standby as "warm reserved" nodes in the appliance, and tag them so usage metering separates active vs standby for observability.
ari (AE): Customer is willing to sign a POC addendum that includes conversion clause. Also they raised KMS/HSM integration for key isolation — security questionnaire flagged it.
legal-bot: Please attach security addendum template S-2B. HSM integrations require customer-supplied certs and SC-4 review. Legal will need a completed security questionnaire before platform fee adjustments are finalized.
maria (Deal Desk): Proposal: Approve 30% node discount for first 3 months + 50% platform fee waiver month 1, contingent on signed POC addendum with commit trigger and completed security questionnaire. Need finance + legal signoff.
shawn (Finance): I can approve up to $5k credit from Sales Ops budget. For additional $2.2k we need RevOps signoff. Ask RevOps if they can pull for POC program.
jess (Sales Ops): I'll ping revops now. Also we should create a special SKU: POC-WARM-3C-3S to track discounts and billing properly.
ari (AE): Customer requested a one-pager explaining billing flow and fallback (what happens post-POC). Can someone draft the bill-run example for them?
sam (Solutions Eng): I'll drop a short example: Month1: platform fee 50% waived, nodes billed at discounted rate. Month2-3: platform fee normal, nodes discounted 30% for 3 nodes. After conversion: standard committed pricing kicks in, credits reconciled.
maria (Deal Desk): Two blockers before final approval: 1) legal signoff on addendum 2) RevOps confirmation they can invoice special SKU with credit schedule. Once those are green, deal desk will sign off and I will send a central approval note.
ari (AE): Thanks — timeline: customer wants final numbers by EOD Fri. I'm on their call Thursday; would like an approved offer before.
jess (Sales Ops): RevOps replied: can do special SKU and proration, but needs deal desk approval email + legal doc. They estimate 24-48 hours to configure.
shawn (Finance): I'll escalate the extra $2.2k to RevOps/Finance lead; if they approve, I'll mark budget approved.
legal-bot: Assigned to legal counsel @elaine. ETA 2 business days for addendum review unless redlines appear.
maria (Deal Desk): Action items: @sam prepare billing example, @jess create POC SKU in quote tool (draft), @eli (RevOps) approve invoice flow, @elaine (Legal) review addendum. If all done by Thu morning we can sign Friday.
ari (AE): Copy that. I'll prep the customer-facing POC doc and loop on the call Thurs.
sam (Solutions Eng): FYI — security SQ flagged HSM availability in their datacenter; we may need an engineers-on-call window for HSM integration during onboarding. That might add a small services fee — include as optional line item.
jess (Sales Ops): Noting optional services fee line.
ari (AE): If deal desk approves the 30%/50% structure, I'll accept and send the signed addendum on behalf of the AE.
maria (Deal Desk): Tentatively approved pending legal + RevOps. I'll post final approval here once both sign off. :white_check_mark:
ari (AE): Thanks team. Will update after Thurs call.
